correctness.rationale: Positive-support independence confines all positive labels to one part. The double Roman conditions then forbid both zero and one labels inside that supporting part, leaving only labels 2 and 3. Every outside zero sees the entire supporting part, so feasibility is exactly the presence of a 3 or at least two 2s. Direct binomial counting gives the enumerator. Exhaustive definition-level verification agrees for every complete multipartite isomorphism type through order nine.
